assign.outcome:
**Eight accepted critique fixes, all executed at the cause — one of them refuted in part.**

Every fix was re-run against the critique's own repro. Both keepers measured unchanged, before the first edit and after the last: the **homepage grid** (stage box 352 / 619 / 1443 at 400 / 1920 / 3440, identical) and the **1920 reading layout** (prose x=310 w=1280, exhibits still `float: right` at x=989 w=602, rail x=1637, on all six posts).

| | fix | proof |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `/index.html` ships description, canonical, full `og:` + `twitter:summary_large_image` | curl below; charset still the first meta, byte 49 |
| 2 | the tooling post no longer claims *every page was built by Claude* | opener rewritten to who built the framework and who directs the agents |
| 3 | the homepage demo emits **no** dead href | 16 internal hrefs, **0 dead** (was 20 / 4 dead) |
| 4 | the `.demo-note` tint band paints full width, text keeps the measure | 3440: band **1441 / 1443 (100%)**, was 648 (45%); text 648 |
| 5 | the first exhibit pins beside the head above 130em of container | 3440 first-thing-in-track: 1284 and 1138 → **54** |
| 6 | `/blog/` + three sections get cards; width/height/alt everywhere; two letterboxed images re-cropped | 10/10 shells `ok`, exit 0 |
| 7 | blogx cards top-aligned — the unmarked void is gone | air above the headline 333–387px → **16–46px**, five shells |
| 8 | the drag seam demo widened past core's 32em floor | `.page-column-grab` `display: none` → **block**; drag proved, [202,372] → [262,312] |

**REFUTED, in part — #5 over-counted.** The critique named three posts; only **two** were broken. `how-this-blog-works` has a `.blog-lead` at y=54 and always did — the probe measured `.blog-exhibit` and did not see it.

![The AI dashboard at 3440: the day board now fills what was 2000px of dead grey](item5-3440-after.png)

**The curl proof** — `/` had zero meta tags before this:

```
<meta name="description" content="Native ES modules served exactly as written: no build step, no runtime dependencies...">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://lew42.com/">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://lew42.com/blog/framework/hello-lew42/no-build.png">
<meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
<meta property="og:image:height" content="700">
<meta property="og:image:alt" content="The framework's own front page: the no-build headline...">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
```

**Two traps caught mid-flight, both invisible if you only read the diff**

- `demo()` prints the function it ran, so the five-line comment explaining `urls: false` **published itself** into the homepage's flagship code pane. Moved above the call; both traps are now a line in [ext/demo's readme](/framework/ext/demo/).
- The field name the brief suggested for #6, `card:`, would have broken preview cards — `Page.nav()` already reads `this.card` as a **CSS class**, and a `Post` assigns every manifest field onto the Page. It is `card_image:`.

**Left, deliberately**

- **65 other `demo.app()` call sites were not audited.** Flipping the default to `urls: false` fixes them all at once and would strip real hrefs from `page.demo()` boxes showing real pages — a dozen-caller decision, so it is yours.
- **`lead: true` may make #5 redundant** for the two posts it fixes. It is the pre-existing answer to exactly this complaint, and how-this-blog-works already uses it. Worth deciding before this ships.
- `/imagine/cms/welcome/page.js` still 404s on every `/imagine/` cold load — real, benign, core-owned, diagnosed in [critique-imagine](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/critique-imagine/) and out of this fence.

**Verification, all of it** — `meta.mjs` 10/10 `ok` exit 0; the repo's own `check.mjs` over 19 urls (run against a private :8095, since :80 is intentionally down) all `ok`, no overflow, no markdown errors; a 15-url console sweep clean but for the one 404 above; keyboard `Enter` and `aria-current` re-proved inside the demo box; both new `card.png` files opened and looked at.
